nodes.name: DFT Structure Optimization
nodes.procedure: Seven types of B-doped graphene SACs with 26 transition metals constructed. Spin-polarized DFT calculations using VASP/PAW, GGA-PBE+TS dispersion, 500 eV plane-wave cutoff, 20 Å vacuum, 3×3×1 k-mesh. Energy convergence 10⁻⁶ eV/atom, force convergence 0.01 eV/Å⁻¹.
nodes.source_text: Fig. 1 (a) Structures of B-doped graphene with single metal atoms (26 transition metals) considered for screening... energy and force convergence limits were 10^-6 eV per atom and 0.01 eV Å^-1

unit_operations.name: SACs Construction
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: seven different types of coordination in SACs were constructed as shown in Fig. 1a

unit_operations.name: DFT Optimization
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: For optimization purposes, the energy and force convergence limits were 10^-6 eV per atom

nodes.name: Machine Learning Screening
nodes.procedure: Deep neural network (DNN) screening using Keras library with input layer, two hidden layers (tanh activation), output layer (sigmoid), Adam optimizer with L2 regularization (2×10^-3). Trained on ~500 samples (85% training, 15% testing) to classify eligible catalysts based on three key NRR steps: ΔE_N2 < -0.50 eV, ΔG_N2-N2H < 0.55 eV, ΔG_NH2-NH3 < 0.7 eV.
nodes.source_text: We designed a DNN for screening using the Keras library... Samples with a probability more than 0.5 were considered as eligible candidates for the NRR.

unit_operations.name: DNN Training
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: Adam optimizer with weight decay L2 regularization coefficient: 2×10^-3

nodes.name: Free Energy Prediction
nodes.procedure: Light gradient boosting machine (LGBM) regression model trained on 15 features (PCA1-PCA7, χ, Z, R, NC, fB, NM, NN, NH) to predict adsorption energies and free energies (RMSE = 0.11 eV).
nodes.source_text: Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LGBM) model (Fig. 4, RMSE = 0.11 eV)
